title: 1,000 Hours of Studying The Most Profitable Apps in 17 Minutes
description:
Start building & deploying paywalls in 10 minutes flat: https://superwall.com/

Join the October 12th LIVE Class: https://www.joinconsumerclub.com/rsvp?utm_content=092326

Create mobile apps by chatting with AI: Get 20% off your first month https://rork.com/?ref=SUPERWALL

Spy on outlier TikToks that went viral promoting apps: https://spytok.com/

Hosted & produced by Joseph Choi: https://twitter.com/JosephKChoi

Most app founders in 2026 are still running the same playbook: buy attention with Facebook ads, fight creative fatigue, repeat. 

Meanwhile, teenagers with vibe-coded apps are hitting six figures a month from TikTok videos, and almost nobody explains how. 

I've spent two years interviewing over 1,000 of these founders and operators, from Halo ($0 to $300K/month in 45 days) to Studyfetch ($10M ARR) to Coconote ($6.7M/year), and running growth for apps doing $1–5M ARR off a single channel. 

This is everything I've learned from behind the scenes.

You'll learn:
1️⃣ The math behind why organic runs at 50–80% margins while paid ads barely clear 30%
2️⃣ The three ways to turn one viral organic video into your best-performing paid ads
3️⃣ The tells that predict whether a content strategy will blow up or flop within a week
4️⃣ The 3 layers of creative strategy, and the one that makes you the market leader instead of a copycat
5️⃣ How a language app competing with Duolingo hit $500K/month and 1B+ views with one format
6️⃣ The 3 hires every organic growth team needs, and why the "all-rounder" doesn't exist

Topics this video covers: how to grow an app, how to start an app no code, app growth, app marketing strategy, app marketing, no code app, ugc app strategy, how to grow an app with ugc, 10,000 app users, how to get 10,000 app users, app growth guide
